detailed_description: The Grouped Bar Chart Generator enables developers to create multi-series categorical visualizations by rendering scalable vector graphics (SVG) that display parallel data comparisons. This tool specializes in ECharts-based browser chart rendering-based data binding, allowing users to map JSON or CSV inputs to X (categorical), Y (numerical), and Z (grouping) dimensions. Unlike standard charting libraries, it implements nested scales for secondary axis alignment and supports custom color schemes via HEX/RGB inputs. The engine performs automatic domain scaling with optional manual overrides, handles collision detection for clustered bars, and generates interactive legends with click-to-toggle functionality. Developers benefit from its ability to produce publication-quality visualizations for dashboards, research papers, or business intelligence reports where side-by-side metric comparisons across multiple variables are required.
usage_steps: Paste tabular data with headers in CSV or JSON format into the input panel
Select categorical axis (X) and numerical axis (Y) from detected fields
Assign grouping dimension (Z) to create clustered bar sets
Customize bar width, spacing ratios, and color gradients using HEX/RGB pickers
Enable data labels, error bars, or gridlines through the display settings panel
Export generated SVG code or download PNG/PDF renderings with specified resolution
usage_examples: Comparing quarterly revenue across three product lines with regional breakdowns
Visualizing A/B test results showing conversion rates across device types and demographics
Displaying scientific experiment data with mean values and error margins for multiple trials
Tracking monthly energy consumption patterns across different building sectors in a sustainability report
